title: Program Officer Playbook
summary: Using HAI for program design, proposal drafting, and workplan review — grounded in Sphere, CHS, and live crisis data rather than model memory.

title: Protection Officer Playbook
summary: Using HAI for protection mainstreaming checks, referral pathway lookups, and template drafting — with a hard line against any identifiable case data.

title: MEAL Officer Playbook
summary: Using HAI for indicator design, survey question review, and qualitative coding assistance across Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning work.

title: Communications Officer Playbook
summary: Using HAI for sitrep summarization, donor reporting drafts, and multilingual drafting — with every fact traced back to a source before publication.

title: Grants & Partnerships Officer Playbook
summary: Using HAI for donor compliance checks, budget narrative drafting, and due diligence summaries — always grounded in current guidance text, never model memory of donor rules.

title: Field Logistics Officer Playbook
summary: Using HAI for procurement document drafting, distribution planning aids, and supply pipeline queries — never for vendor decisions or real-time safety calls.
